inputs.text: [excited] Ty… ran… no… saurus rex. [curious] Do you know what "tyranno" means? [pauses] A ruler who answers to no one — nobody gets to say no to him.
[chuckles] His mom, yes, back when he was little. [warmly] But once he was grown, he was the king. He lived in North America, [amazed] sixty-six million years ago.
[curious] And who did this king rule over?
[happily] His whole kingdom! [confident] All around him lived Triceratops, Edmontosaurus, and Ankylosaurus, [pauses] and every one of them kept a careful eye on him.
